title: Lachy Groom backs Indian startup aiming to keep aircraft aloft for a year
summary: Alteon, a startup founded by a 20-year-old, is developing autonomous aircraft designed to harvest wind energy to stay aloft for extended periods, backed by venture capitalist Lachy Groom. The technology aims to potentially keep aircraft operational for months, representing a significant advancement in long-duration aerial systems.
content: Founded by a 20-year-old, Alteon is developing autonomous aircraft that hopes to harvest wind energy to stay aloft for several months.

zh.title: Lachy Groom支持印度初创企业开发能在空中持续飞行一年的飞机
zh.summary: 由20岁创始人创办的初创公司Alteon正在开发自主无人机，通过收集风能实现长时间空中飞行，获得风险投资家Lachy Groom的支持。该技术可能使飞机持续运行数个月，代表了长续航航空系统的重大进展。

title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
summary: Apple has presented evidence against a former employee accused of stealing confidential company data for OpenAI, alleging the employee destroyed evidence after learning of the investigation. The case highlights concerns about corporate espionage and data security in the competitive AI industry.
content: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.

zh.title: 苹果公开"令人震惊的证据"控告前员工为OpenAI窃取公司数据
zh.summary: 苹果提交了针对被指控为OpenAI窃取机密公司数据的前员工的证据，并指控该员工在得知调查后销毁了证据。该案件凸显了在激烈竞争的人工智能行业中对企业间谍活动和数据安全的担忧。
